concerns.text: Tasks T072 (Interaction Pattern Analysis) and T074 (Sensitivity Analysis Update) introduce 'Collaboration Density' metrics and threshold sweeps not present in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-008) or plan.md. This constitutes silent scope creep and a violation of the 'No silent constitution drift' principle, as these metrics are not authorized by the approved requirements.

Task T073 expands the 'Limitations' section to discuss 'physiological proxies (pupil dilation, HRV)' which are not mentioned in spec.md (SC-006, SC-009) or plan.md. This introduces unrequested content that dilutes the focus on authorized proxy metrics and violates the constraint that tasks must not relax or drift from the spec's defined scope.

Task T051 implements a 'stratified result' by splitting the dataset, but SC-008 explicitly requires the analysis to show effect size changes 'when controlling for AI Noise' (implying a covariate in the regression model) OR filtering. T051 only addresses the filtering/splitting aspect and omits the 'controlling for' (covariate) requirement, potentially failing to satisfy the full scientific constraint of SC-008.
